title: SegRefiner: Towards Model-Agnostic Segmentation Refinement with Discrete Diffusion Process
mechanism: Discrete diffusion over per-pixel coarse/fine states: a U-Net on image + current mask predicts the fine mask and confidence, and pixels transition coarse -> fine over T = 6 steps; trained on GT degraded by morphological perturbation.
adaptation: Fine-tune the HR model on our inactive regions and per-crack crops (1-channel EL repeated to 3); training masks from out-of-fold predictions plus morphological perturbation. Expect n.d. on cracks given the DRIVE result; mainly an inactive and benchmark baseline.
min_experiment: Arm: fine-tuned SegRefiner on house ensemble masks. Baseline: house ensemble. Metrics: inactive IoU, crack IoU on 5-fold CV. Kill: < +0.01 on both.
evidence: R: gains on BIG (semantic), COCO / LVIS (instance, APmk 47.4 reported), DIS5K; trained on LVIS then DIS5K + ThinObject-5K at 256 px. R (rNCA Table 1): on DRIVE thin vessels Dice 0.761 -> 0.760.
prior_overlap: none on our data; the DRIVE comparison in rNCA is the closest negative evidence.

alt_notes.adaptation: Retrain from scratch on OOF house predictions (not synthetic morphology), 512 native, 1-ch EL + coarse mask, separate crack and inactive refiners. Expected near null on cracks given the DRIVE result; included mainly as the standard refiner baseline for the benchmark.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: SegRefiner on house ensemble. Baseline: house ensemble. Metrics: relR@2 at fixed relP@2, crack and inactive IoU. Kill: relR@2 < +0.01 and inactive IoU < +0.02.
